LanguageData.RWS_Setting_IncludeDevMode: Show and count endings recorded in development mode
LanguageData.RWS_Setting_AutoImport: Import saves automatically at the title screen
LanguageData.RWS_Setting_WindowSizeHelp: Applies the next time you open the statistics window. Text size does not change; a window larger than the screen is shrunk to fit.
LanguageData.RWS_WindowError: The statistics window could not be drawn. See the log for details.
LanguageData.RWS_NoData: Nothing recorded yet. Figures appear once the save import finishes (Data management tab).
LanguageData.RWS_TooltipBasis: Computed from {0} colonies ({1} excluded from totals).
LanguageData.RWS_TooltipMissing: {0} saves that could not be identified or read are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_EndingsTooltipPreInstall: Play from before the mod was installed is counted only from traces left in the saves. A trace means "at least once"; the Archonexus ending and other endings cannot be counted from saves.
LanguageData.RWS_ExcludeTip: A checked colony stays in the list but is left out of all totals.
LanguageData.RWS_HistoricalIntervals_Explanation: Partial evidence from directly linked saves. Each row shows the change between two saved ticks. Forks stay separate, and these rows are not added to lifetime totals.
LanguageData.RWS_HistoricalIntervals_Empty: No directly linked saves with a confirmed increase were found.
LanguageData.RWS_HistoricalIntervals_Error: The historical intervals could not be read.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_NotRunThisSession: No import has run in this session yet.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_CorruptRenamed: The damaged file was kept as {0}.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_ReadOnly: Nothing is written to the record file this session.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_SaveError: Could not write the record file: {0}
LanguageData.RWS_Import_Problems: Saves that failed or could not be identified ({0})
LanguageData.RWS_LoadSource_NewerSchema: record file from a newer version (read-only)
LanguageData.RWS_WealthCoverage: Wealth data from {0} colonies ({1} without data).
LanguageData.RWS_Source_RecoveredLineage: Recovered from save (dev mode unknown, excluded from totals)
LanguageData.RWS_Details_ThroughTip: In-game day of the save the value comes from.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Note: From {0} colonies (excluded from totals: {1}). Values are computed from the imported saves and may include what happened through dev-mode actions.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Unattributed: {0} observations that could not be matched to one colony are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityNone: This statistic does not apply to any of the selected colonies. A missing DLC is given as the reason only when the save's recorded DLC list confirms it.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityMissing: None of the eligible colonies has a captured value. The cause is unconfirmed: collection may be disabled or may have started late, the event may not have been captured, or historical import may be unsupported. This is not the same as zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilitySome: Only some eligible colonies have a captured value. The others are unknown, not zero, so the combined value may be partial.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityAll: All eligible colonies have a captured value. This alone does not mean the whole campaign was covered or that the value was verified in a real game.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityPartialPeriod: A captured value may cover only part of the campaign. Do not read it as a verified lifetime total.
LanguageData.RWS_Cross_RankedTypeExplanation: Quantities summed by type across independently selected colonies. The ranking may be partial if any colony's breakdown is missing.
LanguageData.RWS_Cross_ContributionExplanation: This colony's measured contribution to the selected type. Colonies that are not listed or have no data are not assumed to be zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_MissingAcquisitionTip: This may be because the saves predate collection, collection was disabled, or the source data is unavailable. Past events are not filled in as zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_StartGame: Measured from: the start of the game
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_StartSnapshot: The state at the time of saving.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_Unknown: There is no data to base this on (saves read before this version, a missing file, an unsupported game version, or unreadable data).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthItemsPeak: Largest item wealth in the history graph (one observation per half day). All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthItemsLatest: Item wealth at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsPeak: Largest building wealth in the history graph. All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsLatest: Building wealth at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthPawnsPeak: Largest wealth in pawns and animals in the history graph. All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthPawnsLatest: Wealth in pawns and animals at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMean: Mean of the valid total wealth observations. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst: Total wealth at the first observation of a history that is complete from the start. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalNet: Total wealth at the last observation minus the first; negative if it fell. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalPeakDay: Nominal day of the first observation at the peak total wealth (one observation per half day). One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGainHalfDay: Largest rise of total wealth between two consecutive observations; 0 if it never rose.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLossHalfDay: Largest fall of total wealth between two consecutive observations; 0 if it never fell.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLossRateHal: Largest (before − after) ÷ before between two consecutive observations; intervals that start at 0 are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGain15D: Largest rise of total wealth between observations 30 apart (15 days); periods with a gap are not used.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLoss15D: Largest fall of total wealth between observations 30 apart (15 days); periods with a gap are not used.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGrowthRateY: Largest (after − before) ÷ before between observations 120 apart (one year); negative if wealth always fell.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalLongestGrowth: Longest run of consecutive observations in which total wealth rose every time; an unchanged value or a gap ends the run.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst100K: Nominal day of the first observation with total wealth of 100,000 or more. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst1M: Nominal day of the first observation with total wealth of 1,000,000 or more. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsMaxShare: Largest building wealth ÷ total wealth at the same observation.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsMean: Mean of the observed number of free colonists. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsMin: Smallest observed number of free colonists. All colonies: the smallest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsFirst10: Nominal day of the first observation with 10 or more free colonists. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersMean: Mean of the observed number of prisoners. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMean: Mean of the observed average colonist mood (0–100). A 0 recorded while there were no colonists is treated as missing. Not weighted by colonist count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMin: Lowest valid observation of the average colonist mood.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMax: Highest valid observation of the average colonist mood.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodBelow50Days: Half-day intervals with both ends valid whose starting mood is below 50, ÷ 2. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_MoodAtLeast80Days: Days with mood at 80% or more (observed)
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodAtLeast80Days: Half-day intervals with both ends valid whose starting mood is 80 or more, ÷ 2. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathsPerYear: Colonist deaths ÷ elapsed years (1 year = 60 days) in the same save. All colonies: total deaths ÷ total years.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsPerYear: Enemy raids ÷ elapsed years (1 year = 60 days) in the same save. All colonies: total raids ÷ total years.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsLatest: Active mods listed in the latest save, including Core and DLCs. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsPeak: Most mods in any imported save of this colony. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsMin: Fewest mods in any imported save of this colony. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccess: Accepted quests that succeeded and are still in the save. Quests the game removed cannot be counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestFailure: Accepted quests that failed and are still in the save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessRate: Successes ÷ (successes + failures). All colonies: the summed numerators ÷ the summed denominators.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessByRoot: Succeeded quests by quest type (def name). Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestExpired: Quest offers still in the save that expired without being accepted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestAccepted: Quests still in the save that were accepted (including automatically accepted ones), ongoing ones included.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_QuestSuccessDurationMean: Mean days of succeeded quests (acceptance to cleanup)
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMean: Mean days from acceptance to the start of cleanup for succeeded quests; quests without an acceptance time are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMin: Fewest days in the same sample as the mean.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMax: Most days in the same sample as the mean.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDaysByBiome: Total colony survival days grouped by the game's original starting biome; never uses the current settlement biome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankEndingsByBiome: Counted endings grouped by the biome of the game's starting tile, which never changes. Colonies whose starting tile is unknown are left out, so the result may be partial.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankKillsToDeaths: Confirmed hostile kills divided by free colonist deaths over the same recorded checkpoint interval. Colonies missing either value are left out; with zero deaths there is no value.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankMostKills: Most enemy kills in one colony
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMostKills: The most confirmed hostile kills in a single colony, taken from its selected checkpoint. Missing data is not counted as zero.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDeathFree: The longest measured period without a colonist death in any one colony, based on completed periods up to the selected checkpoint.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankMostCrafting: Most manufactured items in one colony
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMostCrafting: The most confirmed crafted items in one colony, taken from its selected checkpoint.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankLargestSale: The largest confirmed sale amount in a single deal, compared across colonies.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankMostResearch: Most completed research in one colony
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMostResearch: The most completed research projects in one colony's save-time snapshot. This is not a count of research completion events.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMinPartyAtEnding: Fewest participants the game confirmed when an ending happened: the occupied cryptosleep caskets of a ship launch, the colonists sent on the Royal Ascent shuttle, or the colonists who transcended at the archonexus. Other endings, and endings recorded before this was stored, have no value.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByDifficultyDays: Colony days summed by the difficulty of each colony's furthest point; changes of difficulty during play are not tracked. Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByDifficultyEndings: Endings counted as on the Overview (dev-mode setting, traces as at least once), by the difficulty of each colony's furthest point.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByPermadeathDays: Colony days summed by the mode at each colony's furthest recorded point: Commitment mode or Reload anytime mode.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByPermadeathEndings: Endings counted as on the Overview tab, grouped by the mode at each colony's furthest recorded point: Commitment mode or Reload anytime mode.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankPopulationPeak: The highest of the game's greatest-population counters across colonies, and its colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankFastestEnding: The ending recorded during play with the fewest in-game days, and its colony. Pre-install traces, whose time is unknown, are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankNetWealthPerYear: Sum of the colonies' net wealth changes ÷ sum of the years their histories span (histories with a single observation are left out).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankTopScenario: The highest ending count for a single scenario (taken from each colony's furthest point), and that scenario's name; ties are listed together. Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDaysByStoryteller: Colony days summed by the storyteller of each colony's furthest point.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankPlaytimePeak: Colony with the most play time
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankPlaytimePeak: The longest real play time of one colony, and the colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankWealthPerColonist: Largest total wealth ÷ free colonists (at least one) at the same observation, and its colony; only where both histories are complete from the start.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMinDeathsAtEnding: The fewest colonist deaths at the moment an ending was recorded, and the colony. Endings recorded before this version have no death count and are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankZeroDeathEndings: Endings whose colonist death count was 0 when recorded. Endings without a death count are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveCompleted: Research projects that went from unfinished to finished since recording began, each counted once. Not the number of projects finished at save time.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveCompletedTick: For each project completed while recording, the game day it was first finished. Shown per colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveDurationMin: Fewest days from the first real work on a project to its completion, including pauses. Projects whose start was not seen are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveDurationMax: Most days in the same sample as the shortest.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_ResearchLiveFirstDay: Days to the first research completion
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveFirstDay: The game day of the first completion, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MentalBreaks: Mood-caused mental breaks of free colonists. Breaks from drugs, genes, psycasts or dev tools are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MentalBreaksByDef: The mental breaks above, by type (MentalBreakDef).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Inspirations: Inspirations that actually started for free colonists. Failed attempts, pawns that were already inspired, and dev tools are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HostileKills: Deaths of pawns that were hostile to the player just before dying, where the damage record attributes the death to the player's side (colonists, turrets, traps, animals, mechs). Deaths without a known attribution are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KillsPerPawnMax: The most kills credited to one player pawn; the breakdown shows who (by ID). Kills known only by their cause are not credited to anyone.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KillsByVictimKind: Enemy kills split into humanlike, insect, mechanoid and other.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RangedKills: Enemy kills made with ranged weapons (explosions are counted as explosive kills).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MeleeKills: Enemy kills made with an equipped melee weapon.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_UnarmedKills: Enemy kills made with melee attacks without a weapon.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ExplosiveKills: Enemy kills whose killing damage was an explosion.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_EnvironmentKills: Enemy kills by fire or other environmental damage that the record attributes to the player's side. Natural deaths and unattributed ones are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TurretKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player turret.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TrapKills: Enemy kills caused by a player trap.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TameAnimalKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player animal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PlayerMechKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player mechanoid (Biotech).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathCauses: Free colonist deaths by the culprit health condition (hediff) or the killing damage type. Deaths with neither are "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathsByRaid: Free colonist deaths split into those caused by a raider, other known causes, and unknown. While raids are not being recorded, deaths count as unknown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDeaths: Free colonist deaths whose culprit was a disease (a condition the game treats as making the pawn sick). Deaths in which a disease was merely present are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDeathRate: Deaths from disease ÷ free colonist deaths with a known cause.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_LongestDeathGap: Longest time without a colonist death
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_LongestDeathGap: The longest interval between two consecutive free colonist deaths while recorded. The time before the first and after the last death is not an interval.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FirstDeathDay: Days to the first colonist death
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstDeathDay: The game day of the first free colonist death, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OldestDeathAge: The highest biological age of a free colonist just before dying. The same value as the longest-lived colonist (P-010).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanMemberDeaths: Free colonists who died while in a player caravan.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyAnimalDeaths: Deaths of animals that belonged to the player just before dying.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyAnimalRaidDeaths: Colony animal deaths whose attacker belonged to a tracked raid.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonistsDowned: Times a free colonist went from not downed to downed. Instant deaths without a downing are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_EnemiesDowned: Times a pawn hostile to the player was downed; being downed again after recovering counts again. The same value as enemies incapacitated (B-002).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ToxicDowns: Free colonist downs directly caused by toxic buildup (Biotech).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SocialFightDowns: Free colonist downs caused directly by the opponent of a social fight.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsByArrivalMode: Successful enemy raids by arrival mode (PawnsArrivalModeDef). The total is the number of raids.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsByFaction: Successful enemy raids by the attacking faction's def.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidPawnsMax: The most enemy pawns generated for one successful raid. Raid points are a separate row.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidPointsMax: The highest final raid points used to generate a successful raid.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidKillsMax: The most kills the player's side made among one tracked raid's pawns while that raid lasted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidBreaches: Raids with a breaching strategy (ImmediateAttackBreaching, ImmediateAttackBreachingSmart). Sappers are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDrops: Raids arriving by drop pod (EdgeDrop, EdgeDropGroups, CenterDrop, RandomDrop).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Infestations: Successful insect hive infestations (Infestation, DeepDrillInfestation). Other insect-related events are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MechClusters: Successful mech cluster incidents (Royalty). Ordinary mechanoid raids are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidLongestGap: The longest interval between two consecutive raids while recorded, not counting before the first or after the last. The same value as the largest raid interval (N2-C-002).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidMeanGap: The mean of the same intervals; overall, weighted by the number of intervals.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidFirstDay: The game day of the first raid, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsRetreated: Tracked raids that ended with some enemies leaving the map alive.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsWiped: Tracked raids that ended with every enemy killed and none retreating. A raid with prisoners has another outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidRepelledRate: Raids that retreated or were wiped out ÷ tracked raids with a decided outcome. Raids whose outcome is unknown (e.g. the map vanished) are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RaidRepelledNoDown: Raids repelled with no colonist downed
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidRepelledNoDown: Repelled raids during which no free colonist went down on the same map.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMean: The mean days from arrival until the last tracked enemy was out of the fight, over raids with a decided outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMax: The most days in the same sample.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMinRepelled: The fewest days of a raid that retreated or was wiped out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstJoins: Pawns who became free colonists for the first time, other than the starting colonists and births. Each pawn counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinRoutes: New members split into recruited prisoners, emancipated slaves and other routes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonerRecruits: Pawns who were prisoners of the colony and joined for the first time by recruitment.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HumanBirths: Humanlike children born alive on the player's side (Biotech). Stillbirths are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinAgeMean: The mean biological age of new members when they joined.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FirstJoinDay: Days to the first new member
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstJoinDay: The game day of the first new member, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SlavesFreed: Slaves whose slave status was lifted (emancipated). Not the same as releasing prisoners.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Kidnaps: Times a free colonist was kidnapped into a faction's captives.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KidnapRescues: Kidnapped colonists who came back through a confirmed route (ransom). Other routes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaptiveMax: The longest captivity from kidnapping to return that was tracked.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_LifeMean: The mean biological age of free colonists at death. Living colonists are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TenureMean: The mean days from joining (or the start of the game) to death or leaving, where both ends were tracked. Ongoing stays are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstSkill20: (Pawn, skill) pairs of free colonists that first reached 20 through learning while recorded. Dropping and reaching 20 again counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinGainPeak: The largest increase of a skill over its level at joining. Pawns whose level at joining is unknown are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Marriages: Pairs that became spouses; the notifications for both partners count as one.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Divorces: Spouse relations ended by divorce. Bereavement and other relation removals are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Lovers: Pairs that became lovers; the notifications for both partners count as one.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SocialFights: Social fights started; a fight between two pawns counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonBreaks: Prison breaks started, however many prisoners escaped.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersReleased: Prisoners of the colony whose release completed. Escapes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersCaptured: Hostile pawns captured and made prisoners of the colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBonds: Bonds formed between a colonist and a colony animal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsTamed: Wild animals that became the player's through successful taming. Purchases are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBirths: Player animals born or hatched alive. Separate from humanlike births.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsSlaughtered: Colony animal deaths by designated slaughter.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsHunted: Wild animals designated for hunting and killed by a player pawn. Incidental fights are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftedUnits: Stack counts of the main and side products of the player's finished bills, including cooking and art; mining, harvests and mech gestation are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftQuality: The crafted items above by quality; items without quality are listed as "none".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftBestQuality: The highest quality of a crafted item (0 = awful … 6 = legendary); the breakdown shows the quality.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftBestPrice: The highest market value of one crafted item when it was made; not its sale price.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Sculptures: Crafted items that are art (sculptures and the like).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MealsByDef: Finished meals among the crafted items, by type (ThingDef).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_UniqueCraftedDefs: The number of item types (ThingDef) crafted at least once.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_CraftDailyPeak: Most items crafted in a day
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftDailyPeak: The most items crafted in one game day; only days recorded from start to end count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestCrafter: The crafted count of the pawn who crafted the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestCook: The meal count of the pawn who cooked the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestUnits: Stack counts of the main products player pawns harvested; additional yields are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestByCrop: The harvest by the crop it came from (plant ThingDef); harvests whose crop is not known are "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TopCrop: The crop with the largest harvest, and that amount.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestYearPeak: The largest harvest in one game year; only years recorded from start to end count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestHarvester: The harvest of the pawn who harvested the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestFailures: Plants whose harvest by a player pawn actually failed. Not the same as plants dying.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CropsSownDefs: The number of crop types sown at least once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MiningUnits: Stack counts of what player pawns' mining produced.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestMiner: The amount mined by the pawn who mined the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Constructions: Player construction frames completed into buildings. Reinstallations and blueprints are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ConstructionMaterials: The materials completed frames held, by type (ThingDef). Different materials are not added together.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestBuilder: The completed constructions of the pawn who completed the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ConstructionFailures: Times a construction failed. Cancellations are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Deconstructions: Player buildings whose deconstruction order completed. Deconstruction for a replacing blueprint is not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Repairs: Times a repair job brought a player building back to full hit points.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PodsLaunched: Player transport pods launched (pods, not launches).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodSpoiled: Stack counts of player food destroyed by rotting. Burning and eating are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodNutrition: The nutrition free colonists actually took in by eating.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodHarvestPerCell: Main harvest of crops standing in growing zones divided by the growing-zone cells integrated over the same time (cell-days). Hydroponics and wild plants are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeDeals: Deals in which at least one non-currency item changed hands. Empty deals, gifts and failures are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeVisitingCaravan: Deals with traders visiting the colony on foot. Trading at other settlements is separate.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesTotal: The contract value of non-currency items sold in completed deals (silver).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBuysTotal: The contract value of non-currency items bought in completed deals (silver).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesPeak: The largest sale total of one deal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBuysPeak: The largest purchase total of one deal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesPeakUnit: The highest contract value ÷ count of a sold line.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesUnits: Stack counts of non-currency items sold.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBuysUnits: Stack counts of non-currency items bought.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeTopSold: The item type sold most, and how many.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeTopBought: The item type bought most, and how many.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSoldDefs: The number of non-currency item types sold.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBoughtDefs: The number of non-currency item types bought.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradePartnerFactionDefs: The number of known faction types traded with; partners without a faction are shown apart as "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_GiftGoodwill: The goodwill the receiving faction actually gained from each gift; 0 when its goodwill was already at the maximum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AllyToHostile: Times a faction's relation went from ally to hostile.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Reconciled: Times a hostile faction's relation became neutral or ally.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AidRequests: Military aid requests a friendly faction accepted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AidArrivals: Times friendly reinforcements actually arrived. Not the same as requests.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Tends: Times a tend was performed; one tend of several wounds counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TendQualityMean: The mean quality applied to each condition a tend treated.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestTender: The tends of the pawn who tended the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID). Tends without a known doctor are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_NeutralTends: Tends whose patient was a neutral pawn.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Surgeries: Surgeries with a decided outcome (success or failure). Cancellations are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SurgerySuccessRate: Successful surgeries ÷ surgeries with a decided outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestSurgeon: The successful surgeries of the pawn with the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Implants: Artificial parts and implants installed by successful surgeries.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Rescues: Rescues completed by putting the pawn into a bed. Ordinary hauling and captures are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HostileRescues: Rescues of pawns that were hostile to the player when put into bed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AwayRescues: Rescues on a map that is not a player home.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Resurrections: Times a free colonist came back from death.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResurrectionsPerPawnMax: The most resurrections of one pawn; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseOnsets: Diseases newly contracted by free colonists.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDurationMean: The mean days from onset to cure of diseases tracked throughout; those removed by death or amputation are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InfectionRecoveries: Infections that went away by healing; removals by death or amputation are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InfectionDurationMax: The most days from onset to recovery of an infection tracked throughout.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodPoisonings: Times a free colonist got food poisoning.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Addictions: Addictions newly added to free colonists. Severity changes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Overdoses: Times a free colonist newly overdosed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Withdrawals: Times a free colonist's drug addiction entered its withdrawal stage (its chemical need fell into withdrawal). Each entry counts once; an addiction already in withdrawal when recording began is not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HospitalStayMean: Mean days a free colonist lay in the same medical bed, from lying down to getting up. Lying down again in the same bed right away (a job switch in bed) continues the stay; stays ending in death, or begun before recording, give no sample.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PartsLost: Times a free colonist lost a body part. Parts lost along with it and parts removed by surgery are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Scars: Times a free colonist's injury became permanent.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InjuriesPerPawnMax: The new injuries of the free colonist with the most; the breakdown shows who (by ID).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WildAnimalInjuries: New injuries of free colonists from wild animal attacks.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ToxicFalloutDays: Days during which at least one toxic fallout was active, overlaps counted once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SolarFlares: Solar flares that began; ones already running when recording started are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SolarFlareDays: Days during which at least one solar flare was active, overlaps counted once; not per-device downtime.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CropBlights: Successful crop blight incidents; not the number of blighted plants.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Meteors: Successful meteorite incidents; not the number of pieces.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Fires: Fires that started on a player home map in a cell without fire, other than by spreading.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BuildingsBurned: Completed player buildings destroyed directly by fire damage.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanDepartures: Player caravans newly formed by leaving a map. Merges and splits are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravansLost: Tracked caravans whose every member died.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanTiles: Steps of player caravans to an adjacent tile on foot. Teleports are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanUniqueTiles: Distinct tiles (layer and tile) reached on foot; a tile visited again counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanLongestExpedition: The most days from departure to returning to a player home, for expeditions tracked throughout; caravans that split or merged are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanLongestDistance: The most tiles walked in one completed expedition.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanConcurrentMax: The most player caravans that existed at once, moving or not.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SitesCleared: Enemy faction settlements destroyed by the player's victory.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SettlementsFounded: New player settlements founded from a caravan or an existing map. The starting settlement, moving the colony and gravship landings are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SettlementsAbandoned: Player settlements abandoned by choice. Automatic removals such as a gravship takeoff are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AncientDangersOpened: Sealed ancient shrines (the ancient dangers on player settlement maps) whose interior was opened, each counted once. A shrine counts when the game would consider it revealed, that is, when the fog over its centre clears. Breaking other walls or enemies appearing does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyStartingBiome: Biome (DefName) of the game's starting tile, which never changes, rather than the current colony site; unknown when the world tile cannot be resolved.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchSnapshotFinished: Number of research projects completed at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchSnapshotFinishedR: Completed research projects divided by all research projects at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchSnapshotTechPeak: The highest tech level among research projects completed at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FactionSnapshotRelations: Active factions allied with or hostile to the player at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FactionSnapshotGoodwillRa: Lowest and highest base goodwill among active factions that have goodwill. Permanently hostile factions are included in the faction counts but not in goodwill.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterFree: Free colonists alive at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterPrisoners: Living prisoners of the colony at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterSlaves: Living slaves of the colony at a successful save. When recovered from older saves, a partial lower bound is shown, and only where both slave status and player ownership are confirmed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAnimals: Living colony animals at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterMechs: Living colony mechanoids at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RosterAugmentedPeak: Most colonists with artificial body parts
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAugmentedPeak: The most free colonists with at least one artificial body part at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RosterSkill20PawnsPeak: Most colonists with a level-20 skill
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterSkill20PawnsPeak: The most free colonists with at least one skill at level 20 at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RosterSkill20PerPawnPeak: Most level-20 skills on one colonist
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterSkill20PerPawnPeak: The most skills at level 20 held by a single free colonist at any recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterOldest: The highest biological age of a living free colonist at any recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAnimalDefsPeak: The most distinct species among living colony animals at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterPassions: Free colonists' passions (none, minor, major) for each skill at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAgeMean: The mean biological age of living free colonists at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterInjuredPeak: The most free colonists with at least one injury (permanent ones included) at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesHomeMaps: The most player home maps loaded at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesTurrets: The most player turrets on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesGrowingCells: The largest total growing-zone area (cells) on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesGeneration: The highest total rated output of power generators on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesBattery: The highest total rated battery capacity on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesOutdoorTempMin: The lowest outdoor temperature on a loaded home map at the moment of a recorded save. Temperatures between saves are not seen.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesOutdoorTempMax: The highest outdoor temperature on a loaded home map at the moment of a recorded save. Temperatures between saves are not seen.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockFoodLatest: Total nutrition of food on loaded home maps, including food carried by pawns or held in containers, at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockSilverLatest: Silver on loaded home maps, including silver carried by pawns or held in containers, at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockMaterialsLatest: Steel, components and advanced components on loaded home maps, including those carried by pawns or held in containers, at a successful save; shown by type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockWeaponsPeak: The most weapons, equipped or stored, on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockWeaponDefsPeak: The most distinct weapon types, equipped or stored, on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockLegendaryWeaponsPeak: The most legendary-quality weapons, equipped or stored, on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockPersonaWeaponsPeak: The most persona weapons, equipped or stored, on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockMedicinePeak: The most medicine, carried or stored, on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockFoodMin: The lowest total food nutrition on loaded home maps at any one recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPsylinkPeak: The highest psylink level of a colonist seen at a recorded save. Requires Royalty.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechPollutionPeak: The most polluted cells on home maps seen at a recorded save. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBandwidthPeak: The most bandwidth in use by a mechanitor seen at a recorded save. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPermitUses: Royal permits that an eligible player colonist actually used. Cancelled selections do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPsycasts: Psycasts (Royalty) successfully cast by free player colonists. Targeting that was never confirmed does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyQuestSuccess: Accepted quests still kept in the save that ended in success and that the Quests tab shows as related to the Empire, counted at each successful save. Quests the game has removed are not included, so this is not a lifetime total.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyTitleGrants: Royal titles granted to colonists, as confirmed while Royalty events were being recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyHighestTitle: The highest royal title confirmed while Royalty events were being recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyHonor: Imperial honor gained and spent, as confirmed while Royalty events were being recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyConversions: Observed changes of a player-side pawn from one existing ideoligion to a different one. The ideoligion a pawn is given when created does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyRitualResults: Confirmed Ideology rituals by outcome (Def); interrupted rituals are counted in a separate bucket.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyRitualRate: Confirmed successes divided by rituals classified as a success or a failure; interrupted rituals are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyConversionDays: Mean days from a confirmed conversion attempt until the pawn adopted the targeted ideoligion.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyAppointments: Confirmed new appointments of player colonists to ideoligion leader or specialist roles; reassigning the same role does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyFlights: Gravship flights confirmed as completed by a player landing. Launches and route previews alone do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyDistance: Total distance of completed gravship flights (confirmed by a player landing).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyUniqueTiles: Distinct world tiles where completed gravship flights landed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyNewMaps: Completed gravship landings for which a new map had to be generated.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechMechsCreated: Mechanoids produced by player mech gestators, counted once the living mech has actually emerged. Resurrections are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBirthMothers: Distinct free colonists who gave birth to a living baby.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechChildStages: Growth stages actually reached by the colony's children, each child and stage counted once; shown by stage.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechMechRepairs: Repairs of colony mechs that removed their last injury, each repair counted once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechWasteCreated: Toxic wastepacks newly produced by player production that actually completed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechWasteDisposed: Toxic wastepacks destroyed by completed player neutralization. Exporting them or letting them decay does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechPollutionCleaned: Polluted map cells made clean by a completed player cleanup job.
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_Enable: Record all available statistics (on by default)
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_Warning: Unverified captures are collected by default. Some captures can miss or double-count records or add CPU load; mods that are not installed are skipped. Events from before recording began cannot be reconstructed.
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_Help: All units are selected for new installations. Uncheck an item to stop that collection; turning off a unit does not delete its recorded history. Changes apply immediately, without restarting the game.
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_EvidenceMixed: Mix of verified and unverified captures
LanguageData.RWS_Mod_SourceUnavailable: The source mod is not currently installed. Recorded values are kept, but no new values are recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_ModRecruitment_StartedDesc: Recruitment 1.1.2 requests successfully created after recording began. Periods from before recording was enabled are partial. A request cancelled after creation still counts as started.
LanguageData.RWS_ModRecruitment_ActiveDesc: Pending recruitment requests at the most recent successful save. This is not an all-time total.
LanguageData.RWS_ModHospitality_PresentGuestsDesc: Number of Hospitality guests staying on player home maps at a successful save. Not a lifetime visit total.
LanguageData.RWS_ModHospitality_PresentGroupsDesc: Number of Hospitality guest groups staying on player home maps at a successful save. Not a lifetime visit count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftedByDef: Product units successfully completed during the recorded period, by item. A separate series; nothing is estimated for the time before it was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MinedByDef: Mining yield actually placed during the recorded period, by item. A separate series; nothing is estimated for the time before it was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FilthRemoved: One per piece of filth completely removed by a player pawn's cleaning (the vanilla "messes cleaned" record). Partial reductions of thickness and whole cleaning jobs are not what is counted. Recorded only while enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FiresExtinguished: One per fire put out by a player pawn through vanilla firefighting or by beating out flames on themselves (the "fires extinguished" record). Fires that go out on their own are not counted. Recorded only while enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MealIngestions: Meals successfully eaten, with positive nutrition, by humanlike pawns of the player faction. Each meal counts once, including meals eaten in a caravan; other food, drugs and non-player pawns are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HaulPlacements: Player hauling jobs (HaulToCell) that actually put their load down in the chosen cell. Partial coverage: deposits into containers and mod-specific hauling are not counted. Picking something up alone never counts.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HauledUnits: Total items successfully put down by player hauling jobs (HaulToCell), measured by the decrease of the carried stack. Partial coverage: hauling into containers and other ways of moving items are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CleaningJobsCompleted: Player cleaning jobs that finished successfully after completely removing at least one piece of filth. Several pieces removed in one job count as one job. Interrupted jobs are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TreeWoodPlaced: Wood actually placed or merged into stacks after a player pawn cut down a tree (the main yield, measured when the game places it). Partial coverage: extra wood from some mods and non-standard ways of cutting are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SlaughteredButchery: Corpses of animals slaughtered by a player pawn that were later used up by a completed vanilla butchering bill (ButcherCorpseFlesh). The same corpse is tracked across saves. Hunted animals, wild deaths and enemy corpses are not counted. Partial: mod butchering recipes and some ways a corpse can disappear are not recognized.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_MaxColony: The highest recorded value across independent colonies, using one representative observation per colony. Missing readings are not treated as zero. For quantities that describe a state, this is the value in each colony's recorded save, not a cumulative total.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_MinColony: The lowest recorded value across independent colonies, using one representative observation per colony. Only a zero that was actually measured can be the lowest; unknown and not-applicable values are ignored.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_TopType: Quantities are summed separately for each item type across independent colonies, then the totals are ranked. One representative observation per colony is used. Missing, overflowed or untracked types make the result partial. Stock at a save and lifetime event counts are never mixed.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_TopCategory: Counts summed for each recorded category across independent colonies, using one representative observation per colony. Incomplete or missing breakdowns stay partial. Categories may count events or people rather than items.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_Sum: Sum of a quantity measured separately at the representative save of each independent colony. This is not a lifetime event total. Unknown readings never become zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitGroupsDesc: Confirmed Hospitality visitor groups that arrived on player home maps since this statistic was enabled. Replacement groups formed for rescued guests are not counted. Duplicates after reloading are filtered out by event ID. Visits from before the mod was installed are not estimated.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitGuestsDesc: Total visitors in confirmed Hospitality groups that arrived on player home maps since this statistic was enabled. Repeat visits count again, so this is neither a count of different people nor the current number of guests. Earlier visitors are unknown.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitsCompleted: Hospitality: groups that left peacefully (since enabled)
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitsCompletedDesc: Non-hostile Hospitality groups counted after their visit ended, they were seen actually leaving the map, and the group disbanded with no members left behind or lost. Groups that were sent away or reformed are not counted. If the game was loaded while a group was leaving, there may not be enough evidence; such groups are skipped, never guessed.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_RecruitedDesc: Confirmed Hospitality guest recruitments since this statistic was enabled, counted only after Hospitality's recruit action returns with a pawn of the player faction. Earlier recruitments are not estimated.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_ForcedRecruitDesc: Confirmed Hospitality guest recruitments that Hospitality marked as forced, since this statistic was enabled. Part of the successful recruitments.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VoluntaryRecruitDesc: Confirmed Hospitality guest recruitments that Hospitality did not mark as forced, since this statistic was enabled. Part of the successful recruitments.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_ShoppingUnitsDesc: Items added to guests' inventory or equipment by completed shopping jobs on player home maps since this statistic was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_ShoppingSilverDesc: Silver taken from guests by the same completed shopping jobs since this statistic was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_AssignedBeds: Hospitality: beds assigned to guests at save
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_AssignedBedsDesc: Distinct guest beds assigned to Hospitality visitors present on player home maps at a successful save. A shared bed counts once. This counts bed assignments, not guests actually sleeping or lifetime bookings.
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_StartedDesc: Confirmed Recruitment requests since this statistic was enabled. Kept separate from the older built-in series because the way events are deduplicated and checkpointed changed.
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_SilverSpent: Recruitment: silver spent on requests (since enabled)
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_SilverSpentDesc: Total confirmed silver paid for newly created Recruitment requests since this statistic was enabled. Includes extra fees; failed attempts are not counted, and this is not a change in net wealth.
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_PlannedApplicantsDe: Total applicants rolled when paid Recruitment requests start, since this statistic was enabled. This is the planned number, not people who actually arrived, joined or became colonists; generating them may fail.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedStorage: Dubs Bad Hygiene: stored piped water (L)
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedStorageDesc: Total liters stored in Dubs Bad Hygiene water tanks connected to pipes on player home maps at a successful save, each tank counted once. Only connected tanks that can be read are included; this is not lifetime production or use. Values from before the statistic was enabled are not reconstructed, and the value is unknown if the data cannot be read.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedCapacity: Dubs Bad Hygiene: piped tank capacity (L)
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedCapacityDesc: Total maximum capacity in liters of distinct pipe-connected water tanks on player home maps at the latest successful save. Not a lifetime quantity.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PumpCapacityDesc: Sum of the rated pumping capacity, as defined by Dubs Bad Hygiene, of each distinct pipe network in use at a successful save, in liters per game day. This is capacity, not water actually pumped.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_GroundwaterCapacity: Dubs Bad Hygiene: groundwater supply capacity (L/day)
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_GroundwaterCapacityDesc: Sum of the rated water inlet and groundwater capacity, as defined by Dubs Bad Hygiene, of each distinct pipe network in use at a successful save, in liters per game day. Not the amount actually pumped.
LanguageData.RWS_SAU_OrdersIssuedDesc: Automatic vanilla Wear jobs actually issued by Smart Apparel Upgrade. This is NOT the number of apparel changes completed. Only events after collection was enabled are counted. Experimental statistic.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModdedIncidentsByDef: Confirmed incidents from non-vanilla mods that succeeded on a player home map after collection was enabled, by package ID and incident. Separate from the vanilla disaster counters. Gaps in the history are not filled in.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostsActive: Active player-controlled Vanilla Expanded Framework outposts at a successful save. Across colonies, the representative saves are summed. Not a lifetime count or a measure of items produced or received. Experimental; earlier periods are not filled in.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FishingActions: Fishing jobs that landed a catch
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FishingActions: Player fishing jobs on home maps that placed at least one catch. A bonus catch from the same job only adds items.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FishingCatchByDef: Items actually placed by player fishing jobs on home maps, including rare catches and supported Vanilla Fishing Expanded bonuses. Only recorded periods are covered.
LanguageData.RWS_Backup_ConfirmRestore: Restore the backup from {0} (mod {1}, {2} colonies, {3} observations)? The current records will be backed up first.
LanguageData.RWS_Backup_ImportBusy: Wait for the current import to finish, or cancel it.
LanguageData.RWS_Backup_RestorePreferences: Also restore favorites and colony group settings
LanguageData.RWS_Fav_Empty: Click the star beside a statistic or an overview card to add it here.
LanguageData.RWS_Fav_Unknown: This saved statistic is no longer available.
LanguageData.RWS_Fav_NoOverall: This statistic has no combined value across colonies.
LanguageData.RWS_Rankings_PartialNote: Some values are missing or partial.
LanguageData.RWS_Status_SdkEventCapExceeded: {0} statistic(s) reached the SDK event ID limit ({1}). Later events are not counted, so the totals are partial.
LanguageData.RWS_Status_Caution: A recorded value does not mean its accuracy has been verified in a real game.
LanguageData.RWS_Status_TargetIncompatible: Target mod version or capture point unsupported
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeLevelsGained: Confirmed increases in the VPE psycaster levels of player-faction pawns, counted after recording started.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpePsycasters: Free colonists with a VPE psycaster implant at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeMaxLevel: Highest VPE psycaster level among free colonists at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeSumLevels: Sum of VPE psycaster levels of free colonists at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostPawns: Player-owned outpost occupants at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostByType: Player-owned outposts at a recorded save, grouped by outpost type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostDeliveries: Non-empty batches of outpost production handed over for delivery. Items held at the outpost or still in transit may not have arrived.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostProducts: Units of outpost production handed over for delivery, by item.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_DbhFixtures: Dubs Bad Hygiene fixtures by type
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DbhFixtures: Player-owned Dubs Bad Hygiene buildings across home maps at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_DbhActivities: Completed Dubs Bad Hygiene activities by job
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DbhActivities: Toilet, shower and verified washing jobs completed by player pawns on home maps since this statistic was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_SAU_CompletedSwapsDesc: Automatic Smart Apparel Upgrade orders that finished putting on the chosen item since this statistic was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_BankCreditsDesc: Net silver credited by completed VTE bank deposits, after bank fees, since this experimental statistic was enabled. Contract payouts are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_BankDebitsDesc: Gross silver taken from VTE bank accounts by successful withdrawals, before withdrawal fees, since this statistic was enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_LoansIssuedDesc: VTE bank loans successfully issued after recording was enabled; failed requests and repayments are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_LoanPrincipalDesc: Silver principal of VTE loans that were actually issued; repayments and interest are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractDeliveries: VTE contracts fulfilled by delivering goods
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractDeliveriesDesc: VTE NPC buy-order contracts for which goods were actually consumed or carried away; merely accepting a contract does not count. This does not confirm that the reward was credited.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractItemsDesc: Units of goods handed over for completed or partly fulfilled VTE NPC buy-order contracts, including caravan pickups. Actual transfers, not requested amounts.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractPurchasesDesc: Purchase contracts posted by the player that were paid in full through VTE bank transactions and fulfilled with generated items. Cancelling payment, or accepting a contract without paying, does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractReceivedDesc: Units of items generated by player-posted VTE purchase contracts that were successfully paid; separate from NPC buy-order deliveries and ordinary trade.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeCasts: Successful Vanilla Psycasts Expanded ability casts by free player colonists, counted when VPE consumes the ability use; also shown by ability. Queued orders, cancelled casts and NPC casts are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSecurity_TrapsRearmedDesc: Disarmed player-owned traps that were successfully rearmed during play. Only a real change from disarmed to armed counts, not job orders, setup when the trap spawns, debug actions or the mod's own pawn record.
LanguageData.RWS_VaeAchievements_UnlockedDesc: New achievement cards unlocked during normal play, grouped by achievement definition. Debug unlocks and game-startup restore checks do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VaeAchievements_PointsDesc: Achievement points actually awarded by new non-debug unlocks. When the point total cannot be read, the recorded amount is marked partial.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeTribals_EraAdvancesDesc: Times the player's tribal technology era actually moved forward, grouped by era. Initialization, staying at or dropping to a lower era, and restoring a save do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeTribals_CornerstonesDesc: New cornerstones bought with available points during play, grouped by cornerstone. Cornerstones already owned and ones restored on load do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VaeAspirations_CompletedDesc: Aspirations newly fulfilled by player colonists through the mod's normal completion check, grouped by aspiration. Debug completions, aspirations already fulfilled or not assigned, and restoring a save do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeInsectoids_HiveBirthsDesc: New insects spawned by player-owned hives during normal play, grouped by insect type. Cocoon replacement, restoring existing hive members and developer spawn actions do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeCryptoforge_RelayScansDesc: Scans of the Frozen Scanning Relay that finished while a player colonist was on the quest map.
LanguageData.RWS_RimFactory_GroundOutput: RimFactory Auto Machine Tool output placed on the ground
LanguageData.RWS_RimFactory_GroundOutputDesc: Items confirmed as placed on the map by player-owned Auto Machine Tools, grouped by item type. Items passed directly into conveyors or other machines are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_Rwom_HealingCasts: RimWorld of Magic successful healing casts
LanguageData.RWS_Rwom_HealingCastsDesc: Player Heal and Advanced Heal casts that actually reduced a target's injuries or stabilized a freshly lost body part.
LanguageData.RWS_Sos2_OrbitArrivalsDesc: Player-controlled ships that reached a stable orbit after taking off from the surface.
LanguageData.RWS_SimpleWarrants_CompletedDesc: Warrants settled by a player caravan handing in the target, after the target was removed and the warrant closed.
LanguageData.RWS_SimpleWarrants_SilverDesc: Silver actually added to a player caravan as rewards for completed warrant hand-ins.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeGenerator_UpgradesDesc: Completed player construction that replaces an existing player-owned ARC generator in place, grouped by the new generator type.
LanguageData.RWS_VehicleFramework_OwnedPeakDesc: The most player-owned Vehicle Framework vehicles that existed at once in a colony, including those on maps, in caravans, in flight and stashed away, recorded at successful saves. Vehicle types are shown for the save with the peak.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeDeserters_IntelPaidDesc: Intel items removed from player home-map stock by accepted Deserter Network payments.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeDeserters_CriticalIntelPaidDesc: Critical intel items removed from player home-map stock by accepted Deserter Network payments.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeClassical_SenatorFavorsDesc: Senators who were not in favor before and became favorable through normal diplomacy or quests, grouped by faction. Developer actions, senators already in favor, and restoring older saves do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeEmpire_HonorsBestowedDesc: Pending VFE Empire honors actually bestowed on a player colonist when a ritual completes, grouped by honor. Merely receiving an available honor and developer actions do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_Vsie_AspirationsCompletedDesc: Aspirations tied to a colonist's active inspiration in Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded that were newly fulfilled, grouped by inspiration. Unfinished progress, expiry and unrelated inspirations do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_GiddyUp_MountSessionsDesc: Times a player colonist actually started riding an owned animal through a completed Giddy-Up mount job, grouped by animal type. Arriving already mounted, queued commands and repeated observations do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_CombatExtended_ReloadsDesc: Completed reloads by player pawns that actually put ammunition into a weapon's magazine. Each reload counts once even if it loads several ammo stacks. Turrets, auto-loaders, disabled ammo and failed reloads are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VreAndroid_AwakeningsDesc: Player-owned androids with synthetic bodies that awakened naturally through the mood-based gene check. Awakening directly through developer tools, setup at game start, and androids that were already awake do not count. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_SelectedDesc: New expertise chosen by player colonists in the normal expertise panel, by ExpertiseDef. Debug unlocks and restored records do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_LevelUpsDesc: Permanent increases in VSE expertise levels gained after recording was enabled, summed across all independent colonies and grouped by ExpertiseDef.
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_HighestDesc: The highest expertise level actually reached through experience across independent colonies; not a sum of levels or a snapshot of the latest save.
LanguageData.RWS_VefCooking_BatchesDesc: Completed soup, cheese and other VEF processes belonging to Vanilla Cooking Expanded, grouped by ProcessDef. Ordinary bill crafting and output that was partly blocked are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VefBrewing_Batches: Vanilla Brewing Expanded fermentation and aging batches
LanguageData.RWS_VefBrewing_BatchesDesc: Completed VEF fermentation, brewing and aging batches belonging to Vanilla Brewing Expanded, grouped by ProcessDef. Paused, blocked or unfinished output and ordinary bill crafting are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_Gastronomy_SilverCollectedDesc: Silver actually paid by non-player customers for meals at a player-owned restaurant. Partial payments add the amount actually paid; unpaid debts, free meals and unrelated trade do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeDrones_AssembledDesc: Player-owned drones actually spawned by the automated drone assembler when its production timer finishes, by pawn kind. Timer progress alone, failed spawns and hatching from eggs are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeDrones_HatchedDesc: Player drones actually born from eggs that hatched successfully, by pawn kind. Eggs destroyed without producing a drone, and drones made by the assembler, are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VceDeepchem_StoredUnits: Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded deepchem stored in pipes
LanguageData.RWS_VceDeepchem_StoredUnitsDesc: Deepchem actually accepted into pipe storage from player-owned pumpjacks, fractions included, measured when the pipe network confirms storage. Planned yield, output dropped on the ground and storage that was blocked do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeExtraction_ItemsPlacedDesc: DNA items actually placed or merged into stacks by successful player extractions, by output ThingDef. Invalid targets, failed placement, charges used without output and other hybrid creation do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VnpeGrinder_SlurryStored: VNPE nutrient slurry stored in pipes
LanguageData.RWS_VnpeGrinder_SlurryStoredDesc: Nutrient slurry actually accepted into the pipe network from player-owned Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded grinders, fractions included. Grinding attempts, ingredients used without slurry being accepted, and pipe storage by other buildings do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeMedieval2_HoneyItemsDesc: Honey actually placed or merged into stacks after a player colonist empties a player-owned Medieval 2 apiary, grouped by output ThingDef. An apiary merely being ready, failed placement and later hauling do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSecurity_ArtilleryLaunched: VFE Security off-map artillery shells arrived
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSecurity_ArtilleryLaunchedDesc: Shells from player-owned off-map artillery that reached the target map and actually spawned there as projectiles, grouped by projectile. Targeting orders, shells still in transit and shots that never spawned a projectile do not count. This does not measure hits.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeFactory_HarvestedDesc: Items newly harvested by player-owned Autofarmers, counting real increases of the harvest buffer and confirmed placement on the ground, grouped by output ThingDef. Later unloading into hoppers, rejected placement and ordinary harvesting by pawns are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeFactory_SownDesc: New plants actually spawned, marked as sown and matching the selected crop during a player Autofarmer's work cycle, grouped by plant ThingDef. Unsuccessful cycles and existing plants do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_WarcasketFitsDesc: Player warcasket fittings completed through normal welding, confirmed when the project clears and the three matching pieces are newly worn, grouped by armor Def. Unfinished jobs, applying only part of the set and developer completion do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeAncients_RejectedDesc: Player archogen injector results in which the occupant rejected the injection, was released alive and fell into an injection coma. Cancelled work, a chosen result that never completed, and pending gene choices after success do not count. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeAncients_MutationsDesc: Player archogen injector mutation results that destroy the original pawn and spawn one player-owned mutant of the chosen PawnKindDef, grouped by mutant kind. Other spawns, cancellations and pending choices after success do not count. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSettlers_BountyHandinsDesc: Wanted criminals, or their bodies, actually turned in and removed from a player caravan while a positive silver reward was received. Opening the command, missing targets, failed transfers and unrelated belongings do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSettlers_BountySilverDesc: Silver actually added to the player caravan by the first reward payment of a successful VFE Settlers bounty hand-in. The criminal's items, and any silver among them, are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimatomics_ByproductsDesc: Items actually placed or merged into stacks as by-products when a player-owned plutonium processor finishes unloading fuel, grouped by output ThingDef. Returned spent fuel, material that was only processed, and unrelated placements do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_CE_RoundsUsedDesc: Rounds actually taken from player colonists' weapon magazines, or used up when firing directly from inventory, grouped by AmmoDef. Moving ammo while reloading, dry fires, turret use and debug ammo refills do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_CE_SuppressionReceived: Combat Extended times colonists were suppressed
LanguageData.RWS_CE_SuppressionReceivedDesc: Times a player-colony pawn newly became suppressed in Combat Extended, counted once each time it goes from not suppressed to suppressed. Further suppression while already suppressed and developer test suppression do not count. This measures suppression received, not suppression inflicted on enemies.
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_HireContractsDesc: New pirate or mercenary contracts actually concluded in Vanilla Expanded Framework's hiring window with a hiring faction from VFE Pirates. Viewing the dialog, cancelled offers and failed payments do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_HireSilver: VFE Pirates silver paid for hires
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_HireSilverDesc: Silver actually removed from player-map stock when a new VFE Pirates hiring contract is registered, rather than the rounded quoted price. Free contracts add no silver.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeHybrid_BirthsDesc: New player-owned hybrid pawns actually spawned, one each, when a player-owned VGE electro-womb completes a successful growth cycle, grouped by pawn kind. Failed growth, timer progress and restoring a save do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeHybrid_ConversionsDesc: Successful transformations in player-owned mechahybridizers that destroy the original subject and spawn one new player-owned converted pawn, by resulting pawn kind. Starting the machine, waiting and failed spawns do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_ParoleApprovedDesc: Release decisions at parole hearings that actually cleared a completed sentence for a living prisoner still in player custody, with the release itself ordered. Hearings alone, extensions, recruitment options, repeated choices and the prisoner's later departure do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_ExtractedFieldUnits: Rimefeller crude extracted from oil fields (field units)
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_ExtractedFieldUnitsDesc: The actual decrease of an oil field's capacity (CurrentCap) when a player-owned oil derrick successfully pumps. These are oil-field capacity units, NOT pipe volume or item units. Drilling progress, attempted pumping, the field refilling on its own, transfers between tanks and refinery output are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_SentencesServedDesc: Sentences of prisoners held by the player that actually reach their full length in Prison Expanded and become due for a parole hearing for the first time. Parole approvals, release orders, repeated day ticks and values restored on load do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_PhysicalDepartures: Prison Expanded prisoners who actually left
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_PhysicalDeparturesDes: Prisoners recorded by Prison Expanded who physically left a player home map (a successful Pawn.ExitMap), as opposed to only receiving a release or parole order. Any actual departure counts, whatever the original sentence.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_RefineryFuelUsedDesc: The actual decrease in the pipe network's available fuel (FuelAvailable) caused by player-owned Rimefeller refinery processing, measured after the pipe component's base tick. Fuel moved into machines on site during that tick and fuel that was only scheduled or attempted are not counted. Units are pipe-network fuel units.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_PlantFuelUsedDesc: The actual decrease in the pipe network's available fuel (FuelAvailable) when player-owned Rimefeller power plants successfully draw fuel. Empty or failed draws are not counted. Units are pipe-network fuel units, not items.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_ArenaDesc: Player arena bouts with an officially recorded winner.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_RoadsDesc: Completed world-map road segments, by road type. A bidirectional segment is counted once.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_GravHackDesc: Hostile warcomputers replaced after a successful hack by a player pawn.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_GravBoonDesc: Launch boons applied to player gravships, by boon type.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_SchismsDesc: New schism ideologies registered with at least one player pawn converted.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_FuneralDesc: Player pawns brought back by a dreadnought funeral, with life support and warcasket armor applied.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_SpaDesc: Silver actually paid by visitors into player spa facilities, by facility type.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_Museum: Museum visits and learning sessions completed
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_MuseumDesc: Successful player museum jobs, counted separately for recreational visits and learning.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_StorefrontDesc: Storefront sales in which the product was confirmed as handed to a visitor, by product.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_BoardingDesc: Player pawns newly added to the passenger manifest of a player vehicle.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_UpgradesDesc: New vehicle upgrades installed through completed player work, by vehicle type.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_WrecksDesc: Player vehicles spawned by completed construction of a tracked wreck frame.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_RealRuins: Real Ruins sites entered by caravans
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_RealRuinsDesc: Player caravans that arrived at a Real Ruins site whose map had to be generated, with pawns confirmed as entering it.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_CasinoDesc: Slot machine rounds completed on player machines, split into losses and each kind of win.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_Resleeving: Neural stack transfers to empty sleeves
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_ResleevingDesc: Player surgeries that put an existing identity into a living sleeve that was empty before.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_AnimalPedigree: Animals born with both parents recorded
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_AnimalPedigreeDesc: Player animals successfully born or hatched with both parents recorded by Animal Genetics, by animal type.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_TreatiesDesc: New RimPacts agreements made with another faction, by treaty type. Renewing an existing agreement does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_VassalizationsDesc: Settlements that became active vassals of the player through Hegemony. A vassal that is re-established counts again.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_SemestersDesc: Another Education System semesters that ran their full term and were saved to the semester history.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_GraduationsDesc: External students who left at the end of a semester with a completed or excellent result.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_SchoolEventsDesc: AES School+ events completed and evaluated on player home maps, by event type.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_HotelCheckoutDesc: Guest groups on player maps that started their scheduled checkout after checking in.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_CampDesc: New Set Up Camp sites whose camp map a player caravan successfully entered.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_ExploreResearchDesc: Go Explore! research requests that actually advanced a project, by research project.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_DoctrineDesc: Completed investigations into other factions’ doctrines, by doctrine type.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_VendingItemsDesc: Items successfully handed over at player vending machines, by item type. Includes free items.
LanguageData.RWS_NewMod_VendingSilverDesc: Silver actually transferred by visitors into player vending machines, by machine type.
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_OpenTip: Click to open a chart for this statistic.

LanguageData.RWS_Chart_HistoryWealth: Running record of the largest 15-day wealth increase in this save.

LanguageData.RWS_Chart_GameRecorder: Recorded in-game samples by day. Gaps indicate unavailable readings.
